Cài hook = thêm các mục \"Managed by XFi.en: Installing the hook adds "Managed by XFinder" entries to ~/.claude/settings.json (with a backup beside it) and copies a zsh script into Application Support. Other apps' hooks stay as they are. Each Claude Code event runs the script for a few milliseconds. When Claude Code asks for permission, the script waits for you to press Allow or Deny at the notch; with XFinder not running, Claude Code asks in the terminal as usual. Claude Code in a terminal and the windowless sessions XFinder runs use this hook — the Claude desktop app runs no hooks.

Crew là vài phiên Claude Code không cửa.en: A crew is a few windowless Claude Code sessions with roles that message each other through XFinder with the xfinder-crew command. Members always run in ask-first mode: you approve every message between them and every command that needs approval. Reviewers have no file-editing tools. Claude Code still runs a fixed set of read-only commands without asking (such as cat, grep, git diff); a message to another member and any command that can change the machine still ask you. Allow rules already in your Claude Code settings, or in that folder's, still apply: a command allowed there is not asked again. All members work in one folder — there are no per-member git branches yet. Members stop when the crew stops or when XFinder quits. A sender is recognised by each member's own token; any program running under your account can read that token.
